Surprisingly good. Although this app has impressed me, I do have one complaint.

I often get a “Connection Issue” when I try to edit images, and it does get a bit frustrating. I’m not exactly sure what’s happening here, whether there’s too many users using the software at once, or if there’s an issue with the image format, etc.

But when it does work, it’s fantastic, even the unpaid version. In fact, after trying the free trial, I found that the HQ+ and Max filters aren’t exactly better quality, they’re just different filters. In most cases, the free HQ filter actually looks more natural than the paid ones.

I’ll be sticking with the free version, it does what I need it to do. If the developer could fix the issue above, I might consider paying for the full version.
